title: my-web-2026 Tool Registry Manifest
description: Source / build / delivery identity for each standalone Tool integrated into my-web-2026. See ADR-0006 and docs/tools/inventory.md.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Bumped on any breaking change.

slug.description: URL-safe slug. Lowercase letters, digits, dashes. Unique across all tools. Path segment under /tools/<slug>/ and the same-origin artifact location.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for the Tool Registry UI. Optional.

canonical_repo.description: Exact git URL — DO NOT derive from slug. Must match the .gitmodules entry.

submodule_path.description: Path within the parent repo where the submodule is checked out. ADR-0006 §1.

pinned_sha.description: Full 40-char commit SHA. Must equal the gitlink SHA in the parent repo's git index.

branch.description: Upstream branch the SHA was drawn from. tool-pi-game uses 'develop'; others use 'main'.

command.description: Shell command executed inside the submodule. Must be deterministic and fail-fast.

output_dir.description: Path (relative to submodule root) where the build emits the deployable artifact.

delivery.description: How the host surfaces the Tool. Same-origin static is the default.

artifact_path.description: Same-origin URL path under which the host serves the artifact. Required for same_origin_static. Must start with /tools/<slug>.

external_url.description: Required for external_exception. The host must NOT serve an iframe at artifact_path when external_url is set.

iframe.description: iframe sandbox + referrer policy + message contract for this Tool (Issue #465). REQUIRED for every embeddable Tool: the host has no implicit default and fails closed (renders no iframe) when this block is missing or violates the policy enforced by scripts/check-tools-manifest.mjs via src/tools/embed-policy.ts.

sandbox.description: sandbox attribute value, space separated. 'allow-scripts' alone is the only value that needs no justification. Forbidden, always (src/tools/embed-policy.ts): allow-same-origin (on a same-origin artefact it hands the Tool the host origin), allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox, allow-storage-access-by-user-activation, allow-top-navigation, allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation, allow-top-navigation-to-custom-protocols. Conditional (require 'allow' + 'sandbox_rationale'): allow-downloads, allow-forms, allow-modals, allow-orientation-lock, allow-pointer-lock, allow-popups, allow-presentation. NOTE: this pattern is an ADVISORY subset — it requires 'allow-scripts' first and single-space separators. src/tools/embed-policy.ts is the authority and additionally accepts any token order and any whitespace; if ajv validation is wired up later, keep the two in sync.

referrer_policy.description: referrerpolicy attribute value AND the Referrer-Policy applied to the Tool artifact responses under artifact_path (Issue #449 mirrors it into public/_headers). Only values that cannot leak the host's full URL are accepted: 'no-referrer', 'same-origin', 'strict-origin'.

allow.description: Permissions-Policy features this Tool needs from the host. FEATURE NAMES ONLY (e.g. 'microphone'), space separated — the host owns the origin allowlist and derives it from the serving origin (Issue #449). Required (non-empty) when the sandbox uses any conditional token (Issue #465). Rendered verbatim as the <iframe allow=...> attribute by src/routes/tools.$slug.tsx, and mirrored into the host-side 'Permissions-Policy' response header and public/_headers grant.

sandbox_rationale.description: Written reason for any conditional sandbox token. Required (non-empty) alongside them — Issue #465 requires a written reason before weakening the iframe sandbox (ADR-0006 does not state this rule).

host_message.description: OPT-IN Tool↔host postMessage contract (Issue #465). Omit the block entirely unless a Tool genuinely needs the channel: with no declaration the host attaches NO 'message' listener, so an unexpected message from a Tool frame cannot reach host code. When declared, every event must match expected_origin AND come from the iframe's own contentWindow AND carry an allowlisted type.

expected_origin.description: The ONE origin a Tool message may come from: 'self' (resolved to the host's own origin at runtime) or an explicit https origin literal. '*' is never valid. CAVEAT (docs/tools/embed-policy.md section 5a): the host always frames a Tool WITHOUT 'allow-same-origin', so every framed Tool runs in an opaque origin and reports event.origin === 'null' — whatever the src URL says. A declaration therefore passes this schema and the build-time gate but can never match at runtime, on either delivery kind; making one match needs an ADR decision (the two candidate contracts are in section 5a), not a manifest edit.

allowed_types.description: Message types the host will act on. Anything else is refused without dispatch.

source.description: Only 'iframe_window' is accepted: the event must come from the Tool frame's own contentWindow, not merely from a document on the same origin.

privacy.description: Third-party contact + consent contract for this Tool (Issue #498). REQUIRED for every embeddable Tool (same_origin_static / external_exception): the host has no implicit default and fails closed (renders no iframe) when this block is missing or violates src/tools/embed-privacy.ts. Consent is DERIVED from these facts (a cross-origin frame, or a non-empty third_party_origins list, means click_to_load), so there is deliberately no consent_mode field that could switch the gate off. Omit the block only for host_disabled / not_integrable_yet entries, which nobody frames.

third_party_origins.description: Every origin the framed document may contact, as bare https origins. An empty array IS the declaration that this Tool contacts no third party. A cross-origin (external_exception) frame MUST list its own origin here. src/tools/embed-privacy.ts is the authority and additionally rejects wildcards, credentials, and any path / query / fragment.

purpose.description: Why the Tool contacts those origins, in both locales. REQUIRED (non-empty) whenever third_party_origins is non-empty; the consent notice renders it verbatim.

basis.description: How the declaration was established (which artefact / commit was measured, when). Free text, kept short; re-declare after a submodule bump (docs/tools/embed-privacy.md, 'Re-measuring after a submodule bump').

disabled_reason.description: Required when kind = host_disabled. Explains why the Tool is not surfaced.

classification.description: Mirrors the inventory classification. The manifest is the durable source of truth; docs/tools/inventory.md is the human-readable summary.

license.description: SPDX identifier or null when the upstream repo has not declared a license. MIT-required for my-web-2026 embed; null means the Tool cannot be embedded until relicensed.

notes.description: Free-form human note. Kept short; detailed rationale lives in docs/tools/inventory.md.
